scope: Browser Classic now has staged primary/secondary/custom color editing, bounded Canvas size/Image properties pixel editing, configured-versus-remembered New dimensions, persistent theme/skin/custom-palette/startup preferences, and v11 floating size/opacity controls. Opened filenames update the browser title.
shared_behavior: Preserving resize commands and opaque canvas-ground lookup are shared by native/web tool integration. CanvasDefaults moved unchanged from native settings into Classic; native JSON remains compatible. Erasing and Clear Canvas use the loaded project ground, with white fallback. Unchanged resize dimensions do not expand cropped layers or create history.
ownership: Color drafts guard their session owner and source color; dimension drafts guard session owner/state/epoch. Defaults/colors do not publish document history. Resizing is atomic and undoable, retains off-canvas pixels and expands editable bounds. Tool controls capture size/opacity at press and exclude pointer/zoom input. Stable clearance prevents tool changes moving the canvas.
storage: Only preferences enter versioned per-origin local storage: configured/last size, remember policy, theme, skin and custom colors. Document pixels and recovery are excluded. Bounded JSON, supported values and browser canvas admission are checked before use/write. Malformed stored data is retained while defaults are used; denied storage is reported without blocking the editor. Creating/resizing a canvas updates last size; opening a file does not replace that startup preference.

checks.web: 29 unit/UI tests and 1 external UI test passed. New cases cover color accept/cancel/invalid hex, modal shortcut ownership, stale drafts, properties cancel/no-op/limits, crop/expand/Undo/Redo, configured-versus-remembered New, default-policy cancel, floating-control drag exclusion, captured brush size/opacity, independent pencil size, control scroll exclusion, and a reopened non-white PCND ground through eraser/Clear/Undo.
checks.desktop_controller: 95 controller tests passed, 2 ignored after shared resize extraction. The unchanged-size regression preserves a smaller layer without publication.
checks.desktop_ground: 3 native canvas tests passed after shared ground lookup.
checks.native_settings: 10 native settings/canvas tests passed after sharing CanvasDefaults.
checks.classic: 8 Classic library tests passed, including moved canvas-default serialization/selection behavior.
checks.desktop_gui: 4 canvas-settings GUI cases passed, 2 opt-in GPU exporters ignored, after bounded-dialog integration and before the later type-only CanvasDefaults extraction. The complete native GUI suite was not rerun for this browser slice.
checks.static: Final strict workspace all-targets Clippy and wasm32 web Clippy passed; formatting, whitespace and source-length checks passed.
checks.build: Final optimized wasm bundle rebuilt and started successfully in the browser after the ground correction.
checks.browser: One isolated headless Brave/Mac run with WebGPU enabled: typed Image properties to 96x64, Undo returned clean, reload used the remembered size. Theme Light and skin v7 were selected in actual UI and survived reload. Custom slot 10 retained #2080FFFF after reload and painted blue; Undo returned clean. Invalid JSON remained stored while the editor started with defaults; a throwing localStorage getter also allowed default startup with an explicit warning. No uncaught JavaScript errors were recorded. Eight dialog/state scenes and the final editor capture were visually reviewed.

browser_execution: The sequential UI scripts assume a fresh isolated profile and an active PaintCraft page at localhost port 8088. Initial startup uses 1360x900 emulation; subsequent browser sessions render at 1360x763, DPR 1. The color/storage script targets the PaintCraft URL explicitly, brings it to front and emulates focus. Real nonzero virtual key codes avoid eframe text-agent IME handling of key-code-zero synthetic events. Forms/storage scenes precede the final ground-only correction; that correction has host PCND/UI regressions, wasm checks and final browser startup, without a separate live colored-project eraser capture.
remaining: Editable browser text/shaping, transforms, extra brushes/shapes/view actions, clipboard and frontend switching.
Browser workers, large-document cancellation/resource and physical latency qualification, document recovery/storage, confirmed durable saves and actual GPU document composition.
Native Windows fidelity, WebGL fallback, OS accessibility, real keyboard/IME/device matrices and multi-browser conformance remain unqualified. T15 stays partial; T22 conformance stays not-started.
